description: This file contains the implementation of the Banner model class for the OpenCart admin module, including methods for managing banners and their images such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving banners and images.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Represents the Banner model for managing banner entities within the OpenCart admin module. Includes methods for CRUD operations on banners and their images.

methods.name: addBanner
methods.description: Adds a new banner record to the database and inserts associated images if provided.

methods.name: editBanner
methods.description: Updates an existing banner's details and associated images based on the provided banner ID.

methods.name: deleteBanner
methods.description: Deletes a banner from the database along with its associated images.

methods.name: getBanner
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific banner by ID.

methods.name: getBanners
methods.description: Retrieves a list of banners with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalBanners
methods.description: Returns the total count of banners in the database.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Adds an image associated with a banner, specifying language and other details.

methods.name: deleteImages
methods.description: Deletes all images associated with a banner.

methods.name: deleteImagesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all images associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves all images associated with a specific banner.

methods.name: getImagesByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all images associated with a specific language ID.
